title: Smart Data Models - Pumping Station schema
description: A pumping station for wastewater and sanitation networks

address.description: Property. Address associated with the public equipment. Model:'https://schema.org/address'.

addressLocality.description: Property. The locality, which must correspond to the municipality. Model:'https://schema.org/addressLocality'.

addressRegion.description: Property. The NUTS 2 region in which the locality is located. Model:'https://schema.org/addressRegion'.

district.description: Property. The administrative district in which the locality is located.

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity Type: It has to be PumpingStation

backupPower.description: Property. Description of the backup power system of the pumping station. Model:'https://schema.org/StructuredValue'

available.description: Property. Whether a backup power system is available

type.description: Property. Type of backup power system

datasetResponsibleParty.description: Property. Party responsible for the dataset. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

inletPipes.description: Relationship. List of inlet pipes of the pumping station. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

installationDate.description: Property. Installation date of the pumping station. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'

maintainer.description: Relationship. Party responsible for maintaining the pumping station. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

maxFlowRate.description: Property. Maximum pumping capacity per time unit of the pumping station. Units:'MQH'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

maxHead.description: Property. Maximum manometric head that the pumping station can raise the fluid. Units:'MTR'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

maxInletPressure.description: Property. Maximum pressure required at pump inlet for correct operation. Units:'BAR'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

maxOperatingLevel.description: Property. Maximum fluid level in the pumping station intake reservoir. Units:'MTR'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

maxPower.description: Property. Maximum energy consumption of the pumping station. Units:'KWT'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

minInletPressure.description: Property. Minimum pressure required at pump inlet for correct operation. Units:'BAR'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

minOperatingLevel.description: Property. Minimum fluid level in the pumping station intake reservoir. Units:'MTR'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

numberOfPumps.description: Property. Number of pumps in the pumping station. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

operator.description: Relationship. Operator of the pumping station. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

outletPipes.description: Relationship. List of outlet pipes of the pumping station. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

pumpTypes.description: Property. List of pump types of the pumping station. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

refNetwork.description: Relationship. Unique URI identifying the network to which the component belongs. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'

refParametersObserved.description: Relationship. List of references to observed parameter measurements for the pumping station. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

status.description: Property. Operational status of the pumping station. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

updateFrequency.description: Property. Frequency of data updates. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'
